description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home! * Blue Mtn Beach Regional Beach Access (Less than 1 Mile from beach)* Spacious wrap-around Covered Patio* Four Bikes Included * Gas Fireplace* Community Pool * Walk to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery and Redfish Village * 2 miles to Gulf Place Town Center * Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.*Take a journey and find Chasing Sunsets within the quiet community of Ventana Dunes in Blue Mountain Beach, just off Hwy 30A. This bright and beautiful 3 bedroom, 2 bath home offers a vibrant tropical feeling the moment you step inside. You will love the open feeling of the living room featuring a functional gas fireplace. The chef in your group will love the modern kitchen filled with ample storage space to put things for your group's next meal. There is ample seating in the dining area as well. There is a master king bedroom with an ensuite bath, and two additional bedrooms both featuring queen beds, which make this home sleep up to 6 people comfortably. Enjoy sitting out on the spacious wrap-around covered patio, take one of the 4 included bikes to the beach, or simply spend your days at the nearby community pool. Whatever you decide to pursue, Chasing Sunsets will show you why it lives up to its beautiful namesake.Ventana Dunes is a charming village of Blue Mountain Beach, tucked between Highway 30A and hundreds of acres of State Forest. Ventana Dunes is convenient to the beach, shopping, and other hotspots while still being quiet and secluded. You will love the charming community pool and taking a stroll to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for a delicious treat. This community is centrally located, making it easy driving distance to many locations including the neighboring communities of WaterColor and Seaside. The Bed Setup:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedAREA ATTRACTIONS: This is a fantastic location with Gulf Place Town Center only 1.5 miles to the West and Watercolor, Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Biking is a great activity to enjoy as the scenic bike path meanders along 30A. Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from! 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
